text: The track of a horse in the soft earth
why: ¶117 states that a horse's track is plainly outlined in the soft earth in the hollow, and that the shoe fits the impression.

text: Thursday evening, at the long hollow towards Mapleton
why: ¶13 establishes that it is Thursday morning, the journey and arrival took the day (¶47 says evening), and ¶113-117 place the walk at sunset, at the hollow leading towards Mapleton.
